text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Black short-sleeve fitted crop top with white inset collared bib, black pleated mini skirt, glossy black ankle boots.. Add ONLY these accessories: black choker with small metal ring; black belt with rectangular silver buckle; black oval sunglasses. Closed inventory: use each listed item exactly once and add no other objects.
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic complete hollow wardrobe ensemble. Pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio light, portrait 2:3, all items fully uncropped with margins. Image 1 is the exact garment ensemble: keep it unchanged, including every garment and shoe. Remaining images show the exact separate accessory products to add. CLOSED INVENTORY: add exactly 3 accessory products, namely 1) black choker with small metal ring; 2) black belt with rectangular silver buckle; 3) black oval sunglasses. Match supplied product images precisely. Use each listed accessory once, naturally positioned relative to the empty clothing. No unlisted object, no extra styling item, no person, skin, body parts, hair, visible mannequin, stand, scenery, captions or watermark. Preserve white negative space where body would be. The result is one assembled outfit, not a collage.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
